items.title: Sheafification of an abelian presheaf carries a unique abelian sheaf structure and is left adjoint
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: 40 行、阿贝尔预层层化的层结构唯一性与伴随：Pi(F) 逐点群结构（example 桩）+ fibre-product 引理给出 F^#(U) 为阿贝尔子群（作者邀请读者找更简论证属替代路线修辞，计数论证自身完备）+ 茎上同构识别 + 集合层伴随的阿贝尔性经 check-homomorphism-stalks 验证。6 处引用全可解析建桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-sheafify-abelian-presheaf (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 1936-1950

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Pi(F) is a sheaf of abelian groups by pointwise algebraic structure; F^#(U) is a fibre product diagram of abelian groups hence a subgroup, giving the canonical abelian sheaf structure; the adjointness is transported from the set-level sheafification adjointness and checked to be abelian via stalks and the check-homomorphism-stalks lemma (source lines 1952-1991)
